what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in the United Kingdom.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 270489 Ukrainian refugees in the United Kingdom, 5.2% of all Ukrainian refugees.
Germany, Poland and Czechia host more.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every one of those years.
Before that it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory, with the DPR and LPR, from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, after a big change between 2021 and 2022.
UNHCR's figure for the United Kingdom rose from 230 in 2000 to 270489 in 2025, its highest.
Returns from the United Kingdom to Ukraine were highest in 2024 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in the United Kingdom only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
Gender and age are known for only part of this group.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
